pkgmetadata.longdescription: A GTK tray application that transcribes speech to text system-wide on Linux via a global hotkey, using offline Vosk or whisper.cpp speech recognition backends with optional GPU-accelerated OpenAI Whisper and ONNX Runtime voice-activity detection.

use.flag: Add OpenAI Whisper support for additional speech recognition
Add voice activity detection via ONNX Runtime
